core_meaning.primary_meaning: Fuzail is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Excellence, virtue”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fuzail corresponds to the Arabic form فُضَيل (Arabic root ف ض ل (f-ḍ-l); فُضَيل (Fuḍayl)). Its core sense is pious, god-fearing. Fuzail (فُضَيل, Fuḍayl) is the diminutive of فَضْل (faḍl) 'excellence, virtue', from the root ف ض ل (f-ḍ-l). It was borne by the early ascetic Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ. The source gloss 'pious, God-fearing' reflects the religious reputation of that bearer rather than the lexical sense, which is 'little excellence / of virtue'.
